name: Nethershade
text:
Distilled from the Netherworld, this oily substance imposes tenebrous effects. The enfeebled condition from nethershade lasts for 24 hours.

---
Activate 2 (manipulate)

Saving Throw DC 29 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 void,2d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 3d6 void,2d6 poison damage, and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d6 void,3d6 poison damage, and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)
